title: HIL Support Specialist
description:
WHY JOIN EYT?

Â 

Monthly Rate: Php80,000 - Php100,000

+$1,000 Sign-On Bonus â Start in November or December 2026!

New hires whose contractor start date falls within November or December 2026 are eligible for a $1,000 USD sign-on bonus. The bonus is paid in two installments at the 2-month and 4-month engagement milestones. Terms and conditions apply.

Â 

Benefits That Work for You

  • HMO Coverage â Support for your health and peace of mind.

  • $121 USD Monthly Meal Allowance â A little extra to fuel your workday.

  • 10 Days of Paid Time Off â Time to recharge and attend to personal priorities.

  • Annual Rate Increase â Celebrate your contractor anniversary with a performance-based rate increase.

  • Internet Allowance â Extra support to stay connected.

  • Work Devices and Accessories Provided â The tools you need to get started.

  • December Bonus â A year-end reward for qualifying performance.

  • Additional Maternity Leave â Up to 6 weeks of paid leave, separate from your regular PTO.*

Â 

Annual rate increases and December bonuses depend on meeting performance requirements and are not guaranteed. Maternity leave entitlement depends on tenure. Terms and conditions apply.

Â 
Â 

About the Client

Â 

We are reinventing consumer credit. We wildly reduce the cost of capital by using technology to easily tap into people's assets. Our first product is the world's cheapest credit card â backed by home equity. Using many patented technologies, we sped up a process that usually takes 4-6 weeks and thousands of dollars down to as fast as 15 minutes and $0 to get.

Â 

Who are we?

We are a well-capitalized (over $250MM in equity funding) team of technology (Square, Microsoft, Facebook) and finance (Discover, CapitalOne, Goldman Sachs) executives with top-tier investors â Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, Max Levchin, NYCA, Sequoia, SciFi VC, Caffeinated Capital, etc.

Our team includes people who have built:

  • Financial products (Square/CashApp, the earliest CapitalOne credit cards)

  • Consumer products (Internet.org, Xbox)

  • Technology infrastructure (Visual Studio, Windows & Azure, helped design the C++ & C# languages)

  • Mathematics & science infrastructure (computational research at NASA's JPL)

We are missionaries who like to work hard on important problems - and build products that become infrastructure for society. We believe that using technology to lower the cost of capital for consumers is one of these problems - and if we can do it, it could have an infinite impact on people's lives.

Â 

Cultural Values:

  1. Depth and rigor of thought - we try to be rigorous in our thinking & dive into the details.

  2. Minimalist - we are spartan in our design, in our code, and even in our processes.

  3. Speed of execution - we move fast & value decisiveness. We think speed drives quality.

Â 

Responsibilities:

  • Handle inbound and outbound HIL customer interactions through phone, Zendesk, SMS, Calendly, and other approved support channels.

  • Complete HIL Welcome Calls with newly approved customers and ensure required verification, disclosures, and customer understanding are completed before moving the account forward.

  • Assist customers with questions regarding their application, approval status, account terms, payments, AutoPay, available credit, account status, and other HIL-related concerns.

  • Support contractors and HIL partners with application-status questions, customer follow-ups, documentation needs, and operational requests.

  • Monitor assigned partner-support channels and respond to inquiries within established service-level expectations.

  • Investigate customer and partner concerns using internal systems and tools before escalating.

  • Coordinate with Fraud, Cardholder Support, Complaints, Liens/Contingencies, Operations, and other internal teams when a case requires specialized handling.

  • Identify when a concern should be resolved directly, referred back to the contractor, escalated to L2, or transferred to another Operations team.

  • Perform outbound follow-ups for incomplete Welcome Calls, remediation cases, payment/AutoPay assistance, documentation requests, and other assigned HIL queues.

  • Maintain accurate case documentation across Zendesk, Asana, internal trackers, Concierge Desk, and other operational systems.

  • Monitor assigned queues throughout the shift to ensure customer, merchant, and scheduled-call requests are not missed.

  • Assist with account closure, remediation, complaint, fraud, or dispute-related workflows according to the applicable approved procedure.

  • Identify unusual cases, customer-impact issues, process gaps, or recurring partner concerns and escalate them appropriately.

  • Help maintain an excellent customer and partner experience by minimizing unnecessary transfers and driving cases toward end-to-end resolution.

Â 

Qualifications:

  • At least 2 years of experience in customer service, financial services, lending, mortgage, fintech, banking, or a similar operations environment.

  • Strong experience handling customers through phone, email, chat, or ticketing systems.

  • Experience working with external partners, merchants, contractors, vendors, or other third parties is highly preferred.

  • Experience supporting US-based customers is strongly preferred.

  • Comfortable performing both frontline customer support and backend operational work.

  • Strong investigative and problem-solving skills; able to gather information from multiple systems before deciding on the appropriate next step.

  • Excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written.

  • Excellent organization and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple queues and priorities.

  • High attention to detail and accuracy in documenting customer interactions and operational decisions.

  • Experience with tools such as Zendesk, Amazon Connect or similar contact-center platforms, Asana, Slack, Google Workspace, CRM systems, and internal operations tools is preferred.

  • Ability to recognize potential fraud, complaint, privacy, or customer-harm concerns and escalate appropriately.

  • Bachelor's degree or comparable professional experience in financial services or operations.

  • Must be able to work scheduled US business hours and weekends when required.

  • Must reside in the Philippines.

title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer NDA
description:
GT was founded in 2019 by a former Apple, Nest, and Google executive.Â GTâs mission is to connect the worldâs best talent with product careers offered by high-growth companies in the UK, USA, Canada, Germany, and the Netherlands.

On behalf of the client, GT is looking for a Senior Agentic AI Engineer who is interested in solving complex matching and search problems at scale, applying ML and algorithms to hundreds of millions of real-world data records.

Â 

About the Client

Our client is a leading global management consultancy known for tackling some of the worldâs most complex business challenges. With a focus on strategy, transformation, and performance improvement, the firm partners with major organizations across industries to drive lasting impact.

Recognized consistently as a top workplace, it combines deep industry expertise with a collaborative, innovative culture. Its centralized European hub plays a key role in supporting operations across the EMEA region, ensuring excellence and efficiency at scale.

Â 

About the Project & Role

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help design, build, and evolve an AI-powered conversational analytics platform that enables businesses to explore their data, generate insights and visualizations, and make data-driven decisions.

The product helps users analyze promotional performance, answer complex analytical questions, build charts and tables, and generate evidence-based recommendations using LLMs, agentic workflows, and governed client data.

The team is developing a scalable, secure, and extensible agentic AI framework that can be customized for different clients and integrated with other products through standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP). The existing solution is built on LangChain, with plans to evolve and migrate the framework.

This is a hands-on engineering role with a significant architecture and system design component. You will work across the entire agentic AI lifecycle, from designing agent workflows, tools, and integrations to implementing evaluation frameworks, improving reliability, and delivering production-ready AI features.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and evolve agentic AI workflows for data exploration, analysis, and conversational insights.

  • Develop and improve an extensible agentic framework, including orchestration, reusable tools, skills, and conversation management.

  • Build secure integrations with application services and governed data sources, including sandboxed code execution and AI-powered data visualizations.

  • Design configurable solutions supporting client-specific prompts, tools, skills, and data definitions without duplicating the core architecture.

  • Develop MCP servers and clients to enable communication and data exchange between agents and applications.

  • Contribute to architectural decisions and the evolution and migration of the existing LangChain-based solution.

  • Implement LLM evaluation, testing, observability, and security controls to ensure accurate, reliable, and data-grounded AI outputs.

  • Own features end to end, from technical design and implementation to production release and continuous improvement, collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Essential Knowledge, Skills & Experience

Core Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in software engineering, data analytics, or related fields, including 2+ years in agentic AI engineering.

  • Strong Python development skills, with experience building, testing, and maintaining production-grade applications.

  • Hands-on experience building agentic AI systems using frameworks such as Pydantic AI, LangGraph, LangChain, or OpenAI Agents SDK.

  • Strong understanding of agentic patterns, including tool calling, multi-step orchestration, context management, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and multi-agent or cross-application integrations.

  • Experience developing AI agents for data analysis, including dataset exploration, code generation and execution, and result interpretation.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills, including building configurable, extensible solutions and evaluating technical trade-offs.

  • Understanding of AI security, evaluation, and observability, including secure data access, LLM testing, tracing, and performance monitoring.

  • Strong ownership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with practical experience using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, or similar).

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience with Pydantic AI / Pydantic AI Harness and LangChain, particularly migration between frameworks.

  • Familiarity with SQL, pandas, DuckDB, or Ibis for data analysis.

  • Experience with Azure OpenAI, Docker, and analytical visualization tools such as Plotly or Dash.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with retail, pricing, promotions analytics, or similar domains.

  • Experience delivering client-facing AI products from prototype to production.

  • Familiarity with React and FastAPI.

Interview Process

  1. Interview with GT Recruiter

  2. Cultural Fit Interview

  3. Technical Interview

  4. Final Interview

  5. Offer

Why Join Our Client?

  • Join a globally recognized consulting firm building innovative AI-powered products that solve real business problems.

  • Help shape the architecture and technical direction of an evolving agentic AI platform.

  • Build production AI solutions where accuracy, data security, and reliability are essential.

  • Work with modern AI technologies and development tools, including Pydantic AI, MCP, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenAI Codex.

  • Collaborate with experienced engineers and product teams in an environment that encourages experimentation, continuous improvement, and technical ownership.

title: Telehealth Endocrinologist Evenings Fridays and or Weekends
description:
Allara is a comprehensive womenâs health provider that specializes in expert, longitudinal care that supports women through every life stage. Trusted by thousands of women nationwide, Allara makes expert healthcare accessible by connecting patients with multidisciplinary care teams that have a deep understanding of hormonal, metabolic, and reproductive care. Allara provides ongoing support for hormonal conditions like PCOS, chronic conditions like insulin resistance, and life stages like perimenopause, helping patients see improved health outcomes. As one of the fastest-growing womenâs health platforms in the U.S., Allara is bridging long-overlooked gaps in healthcare for women.

The Opportunity

We're hiring board-eligible Endocrinologists who want to focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional care to women who have historically been underserved. To learn more about our mission and clinical approach, visit allarahealth.com.

Location: Fully remote within the U.S.

Your Impact

  • Conduct thorough patient assessments and develop personalized treatment plans via video visits

  • Collaborate with a multidisciplinary care team to deliver the highest standards of care

  • Complete required training(s) and uphold Allara's clinical policies, standards, and best practices

  • Educate patients on preventative care and wellness using evidence-based strategies

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date patient records and complete charting in a timely manner

  • Respond to patient questions and administrative messages and tasks with clarity and care

  • Dedicate a minimum of 10 patient-facing hours per week, including consultations and medical guidance, with prescribing when clinically appropriate

Required Qualifications

  • Degree: MD or DO from an accredited institution

  • Board Certification: Active ABIM board certification in Internal Medicine.

  • Endocrinology Fellowship Training & Board Eligibility:

    • Successful completion of an ACGME-accredited Endocrinology fellowship.

    • Board-eligible in Endocrinology through the American Board of Internal Medicine (ABIM).

    • Commitment to obtain ABIM board certification in Endocrinology within one year of hire.

  • Experience: All board-eligible Endocrinologists are encouraged to apply

    • Women's health experience is a plus!

  • Clinical Independence: Proven ability to function as an autonomous provider with strong diagnostic judgment and critical thinking skills

  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication, with an emphasis on compassion and clarity

  • Webside Manner: A natural ability to build trust and connection with patients in a virtual setting

  • Evidence-Based Practice: A genuine commitment to delivering care rooted in current clinical research

  • Technical Proficiency: Comfortable working across multiple platforms including EMR systems, text expanders, Gmail, Google Calendar, Zoom, and scheduling tools

  • Telemedicine Experience: Prior telehealth experience is a plus

  • State License Requirements & Hiring Considerations: An active, unrestricted, and unencumbered professional license in at least one U.S. state is required.

A note on state licensing: All active and pending licenses held at the time of application are collected and reviewed during our process. Hiring decisions reflect current state-level needs, which evolve over time. Applicants may not move forward immediately if there is no active need in their licensed states. We regularly revisit candidates as needs expand and when experience, licensure, and role requirements align.

Schedule Requirements

  • Evenings, Fridays, and/or Weekends: A minimum of 80% of weekly contracted hours must fall within the following windows:

  • Evenings (any day): 5:00 PM â 9:00 PM

  • Fridays: 8:00 AM â 9:00 PM

  • Saturdays & Sundays: 8:00 AM â 6:00 PM

All hours are scheduled in the time zone of your active state license(s).

What Allara Offers

  • 1099 Contract: The flexibility and autonomy of an independent contractor arrangement

  • 1099 Longevity Recognition Bonus

  • Competitive Compensation: Per-visit rates plus additional pay for charting, administrative tasks, and other patient-related work

  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the U.S.

  • Malpractice Insurance: Comprehensive coverage provided at no cost to you

  • Mission-Driven Work: Help transform the standard of care for women living with conditions that have historically been underdiagnosed and undertreated

  • Collaborative Provider Network: Connect with and learn from a community of skilled, like-minded Allara clinicians

  • Inclusive Culture: Join a supportive, diverse team that values innovation, equity, and belonging

At Allara, we believe in celebrating everything that makes us human and are proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We embrace diversity and are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better we can serve our members.
